title: Bolts loosening due to vibration, thermal expansion, or shock loads
symptoms: Screws backing out, lost clamping pressure, leaking flanges, machine downtime.
root_cause: Side-to-side movement between threads under load causing loss of friction.

recommended_solution.procedure: Clean threads with LOCTITE SF 7070. Apply LOCTITE 243 to bolt engagement area. Assemble and torque to spec.

selection_criteria: Use LOCTITE 222 for small screws (<M6), LOCTITE 243 for standard nuts/bolts (M6-M20, hand tool removable), LOCTITE 270 for permanent high strength (>M20 or studs).

title: Pipe thread leakage in high pressure hydraulic, pneumatic, or water lines
symptoms: Fluid weeping from threaded joints, pressure drop, contamination.
root_cause: Helical leak paths along spiral thread roots under pressure.

recommended_solution.procedure: Clean threads with SF 7070. Apply LOCTITE 577 around male threads starting 1-2 threads from end. Tighten securely.

selection_criteria: Use LOCTITE 542 for fine hydraulic threads; LOCTITE 577 for coarse metal threads; LOCTITE 55 cord for immediate pressure & potable water/gas.

title: Flange gasket blowout, fluid leakage, or bolt relaxation on rigid cast flanges
symptoms: Oil or chemical leaking from split casing or gearbox flange.
root_cause: Precut paper/cork gaskets shrinking, creeping under pressure, or failing to fill surface roughness.

recommended_solution.procedure: Remove old gasket with SF 790 Chisel. Clean with SF 7070. Apply continuous bead of LOCTITE 518 circling bolt holes. Assemble immediately.

selection_criteria: LOCTITE 518 for rigid iron/steel/aluminum; LOCTITE 510 for high temp (>150°C up to 204°C); LOCTITE SI 5699 for flexible/stamped flanges.

title: Bearing or shaft slippage, fretting corrosion, or spun bearings on shaft / housing
symptoms: Noise, excessive shaft play, fretting rust powder, heat generation.
root_cause: Micro-movement between pressed or slip-fit cylindrical metal assemblies.

recommended_solution.procedure: Clean parts with SF 7063/7070. Apply LOCTITE 638 to leading edge of shaft/bore engagement. Press or slip assemble with twisting motion.

selection_criteria: LOCTITE 648 for tight gaps (<0.15 mm); LOCTITE 638 for maximum strength up to 0.25 mm gap; LOCTITE 660 for worn shafts/keyways up to 0.5 mm gap.

title: Badly wallowed keyway or worn pump shaft / oversize bearing housing
symptoms: Loose drive key, rotational slop, worn bearing seat, shaft vibration.
root_cause: Repeated torque reversals and severe impact loads degrading keyway and shaft dimensions.

recommended_solution.procedure: For gaps up to 0.5 mm (0.020"): apply LOCTITE 660 into keyway/shaft with SF 7649 primer. For severe wear: rebuild shaft with LOCTITE EA 3478 Superior Metal, then lathe machine to size.

selection_criteria: Use LOCTITE 660 for emergency / fast keyway repair up to 0.5 mm; use EA 3478 Superior Metal for permanent metal rebuilding and precision lathe remachining.

title: Severe abrasion, erosion, and chemical corrosion inside pump volute casing & impeller
symptoms: Loss of pump flow/head, reduced efficiency (off BEP), thin casing walls, cavitation pitting.
root_cause: Slurry particles, fluid turbulence, cavitation micro-implosions, and chemical attack.

recommended_solution.procedure: Grit blast to SA 2.5. Clean with SF 7063. Rebuild deep wear pockets with ceramic putty (PC 7226). Apply 2 brush coats of LOCTITE PC 7227 ceramic topcoat (500 µm total).

selection_criteria: PC 7226 for thick rebuild of worn volute; PC 7227 for smooth high-gloss low-friction topcoat on impellers & volutes; PC 7117 for extreme chemical/acid resistance.

title: Seizing and galling of stainless steel or high-temp bolts during pump disassembly
symptoms: Snapped studs, stripped threads, galling on gland nuts and casing bolts.
root_cause: Galvanic corrosion, friction welding on stainless steel, extreme heat build-up.

recommended_solution.procedure: Clean threads thoroughly. Coat male threads and under bolt head with LOCTITE LB 8008 C5-A Copper Anti-Seize (or LB 8023 Marine Grade for saltwater exposure) prior to assembly.

selection_criteria: LB 8008 Copper up to 982°C; LB 8150 Silver for stainless up to 870°C; LB 771 Nickel up to 1315°C for chemical environments; LB 8023 for marine/water.
